Information
Charlotte Douglas and Husband Captain Kirk Douglas (of the Roots) are slowing down the tempo at Brooklyn Bowl with a sound healing journey. Bring your intentions and soak in the vibrations! Please bring your own yoga mat or blanket and note there will be no bowling at this event.

Note: 
Doors: 7:30pm Show: 8pm. Age requirement 14+

Ticket Limit
Please note: There is a ticket limit of 8 tickets per person and per credit card on this event.
